messages:
Sam: Quick brainstorm — proposing a 5-email "Welcome Mixer" flow for new signups that dynamically routes based on intent signals (trial interest, eval, content-consumer).
Priya: love the name. can we keep it to 3 emails for low-touch users and 5 for high-intent? :thinking_face:
Jordan: +1. also suggest we surface the benchmark one-pager in email #2 for dev audiences.
Kelly: important: segmentation must be deterministic on first-touch so journey doesn't oscillate if they visit docs later.
Sam: agreed. drafting segmentation rules now. rough rules:

```
segment_high_intent = (utm_campaign contains 'trial' OR clicked '/try' OR visited /pricing) AND email_optin=true
segment_content = (visited '/blog' OR engaged with benchmark) AND not segment_high_intent
segment_passive = signed_up_via_api_key AND no_engagement_7d
```

Sam: plan for messaging cadence:
- high_intent (5 emails): welcome, benchmark, quickstart guide, case study, trial nudge
- content (3 emails): welcome, benchmark highlights, invite to webinar/office hours
- passive (2 emails): welcome + light product tour

Priya: Can we A/B test subject lines on email 1 for high_intent? (short vs contextual)
Jordan: yes — and we should instrument click-to-activation in GA and our internal lead scoring. put a UTM for channel=welcome_mixer.
Kelly: lead routing: high_intent -> sales queue 'Outbound: Trial' immediately; content -> nurture SDR check after webinar attendance; passive -> no auto-assign.
Sam: need exact UTM & team tags. suggested utm_medium=email, utm_source=welcome_mixer, utm_campaign={{segment}}-onboard-2026q2
Priya: ops question — does OpsBot push to Salesforce? OpsBot: Deploy: lead routing webhook updated in staging at 1763456801. Payload: {
  "lead_segment": "high_intent",
  "assign_to_queue": "Outbound: Trial",
  "source": "welcome_mixer"
}
Jordan: nice. timeline? want to A/B for 2 weeks then roll.
Sam: timeline: draft copy + setup by Tue, QA Wed, soft-launch Fri to 10% of new signups, full roll Mon week+.
Kelly: I'll add the acceptance criteria to the campaign board: open rate >35% for high_intent initial, CTR to quickstart >8%, and 10% increase in trial starts from that cohort.
Priya: tagging: please include 'benchmark' and 'webinar-invite' variants as separate creative blocks.
Sam: I'll push the copy draft later today to the doc and drop link here. Thanks team :rocket:
OpsBot: Note: staging webhook logged at 1763456815, no errors.
